relevance: 0 non-answer/off-topic, 1 important requested behavior missing or contradicted, 2 answers the actual question and fulfills its required behavior. A wrong word naming the place/device/action can materially change what the customer is told to do. Minor harmless grammar/style differences need no penalty.

data.question: Customer: Transfer the owner account to my friend.

spans.text: To transfer account ownership, you'll need to submit a formal request through our support process.
Here's how to proceed:
**Submit a Support Request**: Use the [contact form](https://tablecards.com/support) to explain your request.
Include both your account details and your friend's information.
**Verification**: Our team will verify ownership details and ensure this action complies with our policies.
This may take 1-3 business days.
**Manual Processing**: Account ownership transfers require manual review by our support team.
We cannot process this via chat or automated systems.
For urgent cases, you can also email support@tablecards.com with "Account Ownership Transfer" in the subject line.
Note: We cannot guarantee acceptance of transfer requests, as accounts are tied to the original payment method and verification.
